description: This file defines the GrainAddressCacheUpdate class, which represents a directive to update an invalid cached GrainAddress to a valid one within the Orleans runtime. It includes properties for invalid and valid addresses, constructors, and string formatting methods.

classes.name: GrainAddressCacheUpdate
classes.description: Sealed class representing an update directive for a grain address cache, including invalid and valid address details, with string formatting capabilities.

methods.name: GrainAddressCacheUpdate
methods.description: Constructor initializing the cache update with invalid and optionally valid grain addresses, ensuring grain IDs match.

methods.name: GrainId
methods.description: Property returning the grain ID associated with the cache update.

methods.name: InvalidActivationId
methods.description: Property returning the activation ID of the invalid address.

methods.name: InvalidSiloAddress
methods.description: Property returning the silo address of the invalid address.

methods.name: ValidGrainAddress
methods.description: Property returning the valid grain address if available, constructed from stored data.

methods.name: InvalidGrainAddress
methods.description: Property returning the invalid grain address constructed from stored data.

methods.name: ToString
methods.description: Overrides Object.ToString() to provide a string representation of the cache update.

methods.name: ToFullString
methods.description: Returns a detailed string representation including membership version.
